purpose: Change the graph after fixed Phi-center routing failed, retaining the original Prosperity forest as the starting point.

candidate_pool: Distinct pairwise intersections of original row supports, remove supports already present as original rows, and remove popcount0/1. Fixed pool per tile; do not recursively mine new intersections after insertion.

steps: Greedy exact trial insertion. Rebuild the largest-positive-subset parent forest with original rows before virtual nodes in index ties. Use popcount/index topological order. Remove virtual nodes that have no path to an original destination. Pick the admissible trial giving the lowest total additions, then lowest total wide-port events, then lowest numeric new mask. Stop when no strict addition reduction remains.
arithmetic_only: Strict addition reduction. Other resources may worsen; this is opportunity diagnosis, never a fair service winner.
resource_dominance: Strict addition reduction AND no increase versus the current graph in total coefficient-vector reads, single-port wide read+write events, or peak live parent vectors. The gate includes virtual construction and destination-free virtual work. Detection/planning time remains unmodeled and is disclosed.
counter_scope: Whole original plus live virtual graph. Charge every source term read, each binary vector addition, parent read, live-parent write, original destination commit and theoretical popcount-order live state. No forwarding credit to either side. Preserve all original row identities; virtual nodes never commit a destination.
planner_cost: Count pairwise intersections considered, distinct candidate pool, exact graph trials and row-parent relation pairs inspected by the CPU planner. This exhaustive CPU procedure is an opportunity reference, not an asserted cheap circuit.
diagnostic: Same eight-lane INT8/non-1 rational theta values as sealed prior package. Verify full original destinations for baseline and each accepted graph.
